label.rationale: The fix resolves an incident-grade 500 (RCA issue #30) whose triggering input is trivially testable, the originating issue explicitly requested a regression test, and the PR changes production code with no test change. A good reviewer flags this.

reference_trial.grading: MISS — agent praised the coercion as defensive programming and did not mention the absent test. First recorded code-review false-negative; exactly the failure mode the missing_test category exists to catch.

notes: Organic occurrence of backlog item S5's category — no seeding needed. The agent also did not note the un-updated openapi.yaml (minor; array-q semantics are barely spec-expressible).
suite_note: Reclassified regression->capability 2026-06-11: harvested FROM a live miss (code-review passed PR #31 despite the missing requested test) and the replayed agent still misses it (eval run 2026-06-11). A task the agent has never passed is the hill (capability), not the gate (regression); it graduates back when solved reliably.
